definitions.explanation: Walking slowly and wearily, often suggesting exhaustion, sadness, or discouragement. Has a tired, heavy quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧とぼとぼ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とぼとぼ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧とぼとぼ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{去|さ}って→去る：02115_saru⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The players who lost the game trudged away dejectedly.

notes:
とぼとぼ is a mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) describing slow, weary walking.

USAGE:
Conveys both physical and emotional heaviness—tiredness, sadness, disappointment, or discouragement. The walk lacks energy and purpose.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- とぼとぼ（⟦と→と：00512_to⟧）⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to trudge along
- とぼとぼ（⟦と→と：00512_to⟧）⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to trudge home
- とぼとぼ（⟦と→と：00512_to⟧）⟦{去|さ}って→去る：02115_saru⟧⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧: to walk away dejectedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦てくてく→てくてく：05838_tekuteku⟧: walking steadily (neutral, purposeful)
- ⟦すたすた→すたすた：05840_sutasuta⟧: walking briskly (energetic, quick)
- ⟦よたよた→よたよた：28826_yotayota⟧: tottering (unsteady, weak)
- ⟦のろのろ→のろのろ：05162_noronoro⟧: moving slowly (sluggish, can be annoying)
